title: Exchange Desk Guidance — Carry-Over Share and Exchange Courtesy Miles on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, an exchange that carries most of the returned purchase's money over is treated as a continuation of the original sale and earns exchange courtesy miles. Courtesy miles are taken off the transfer distance before the exchange replacement shipping fee is priced; the distance that remains is the exchange pricing distance, and the shipping band and transport price of the replacement are set on that distance. Whether any exchange replacement shipping fee is owed at all is judged on the full transfer distance.

**Carry-over share.** The carry-over share of an exchange replacement is the money moved onto the replacement order by internal transfer from the returned order — the down payments received on the replacement order by internal transfer — as a percentage of the vehicle price charged on the replacement order net of any reversal of that price, rounded half up to two decimal places. Where the net vehicle price charged on the replacement order is zero, the carry-over share is zero.

**Courtesy miles by carry-over share.**

| Carry-over share | Courtesy miles |
|---|---|
| 80 percent or more (the high carry-over share) | twice the program's free transfer distance |
| at least 50 percent but below 80 percent (the low carry-over share up to the high) | the program's free transfer distance |
| below 50 percent | none |

**The same ladder in miles, by the replacement vehicle's program.**

| Vehicle program | Free transfer distance | Share 80 percent or more | Share 50 to below 80 percent | Share below 50 percent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Kestrel Certified | 100 | 200 | 100 | 0 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 100 | 200 | 100 | 0 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 250 | 500 | 250 | 0 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 250 | 500 | 250 | 0 |

**Boundary cases.** A share of exactly 80.00 percent earns the higher figure; 79.99 percent earns the program's free transfer distance. A share of exactly 50.00 percent earns the program's free transfer distance; 49.99 percent earns none.

**Worked examples (hypothetical exchanges).**
- A Kestrel Certified replacement carries a $30000.00 vehicle price, and $24000.00 was moved onto it by internal transfer. The share is 80.00 percent, so 200 courtesy miles apply; a transfer distance of 650 miles leaves an exchange pricing distance of 450 miles.
- A Kestrel Certified replacement carries a $36000.00 vehicle price, and $20000.00 was moved onto it. The share is 55.555 percent, rounded to 55.56 percent: 100 courtesy miles.
- A replacement onto which $9000.00 of a $30000.00 price was moved has a 30.00 percent share and earns no courtesy miles.
